description:
The purpose of this procurement is to award a new DES Task Order for the Stringfellow Perchlorate Study Area. Architect-Engineering Services for EPA for a Focused Remedial Investigation/Feasibility Study (Focused RI/FS) and well-supported Record of Decision (ROD) at the Stringfellow Superfund Site located in Jurupa Valley, California.
